author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
description: Taxonomy of map structures unbound from RPG Maker tile limitations

map_types.name: Provincial Overworld
map_types.description: Macro-scale continental topology connecting provinces and celestial realms

map_types.name: Tactical Battle Grid
map_types.description: Deterministic grid for TRPG and LeTBS positioning, flanking, and terrain buffs

map_types.name: Settlement Exterior
map_types.description: Open-air village, town plazas, roads, and market squares with diurnal states

map_types.name: Interior Chamber
map_types.description: Enclosed dwellings, shrines, throne halls, and astral nexus sanctuaries

map_types.name: Dungeon Labyrinth
map_types.description: Multi-corridor planar rift or catacomb with fog-of-war and destructible props
